svg.text: Three asked, the same word: people 1.7 of 24 (expected), machines 16 of 24
With the people's first word struck: machines 14 of 24. Two words at once, which no norm prints: 14 of 24 (6 of the 12 pairs that share no associate).
Each bar: what about 150 people wrote for one cue, widest first; pale end, words one person wrote. Dark: the six instances' most frequent word.
It is the people's widest on 8 of 24; four times no two people wrote it at all.
machines: trapped, not in the people's list
machines: conduct, not in the people's list
machines: indigenous, not in the people's list
machines: symbol, not in the people's list
USF Free Association Norms, Appendix A (Nelson, McEvoy & Schreiber 1998), 24 cues. Machines: six fresh instances per cue, no tools. Session 153.
